what: On hover, while the button’s background panel shrinks to .9 (.3s cubic-bezier(.9,0,1,1)), the accent panel rises from below to cover it (.3s cubic-bezier(0,.25,0,1), .167s later), and the text turns to the on-accent text color over .4s after .2s. On leave, the accent panel drops first and the background returns later. The selected tab (.is-active·aria-current) stays covered

options.--fx-bg: Base panel color (via style), default var(--kf-raised)
options.--fx-bg-on: Color of the rising panel, default var(--kf-accent)
options.--fx-ink-on: Text color when covered, default var(--kf-on-accent)
options.--fx-shrink: Scale at which the base plate shrinks, default .9
